svg.data-throughput: up to 48 Tbps (datasheet Table 1; the guide gives a net switching capacity of 42 Tbps with six SIBs); 7.2 Tbps per slot
svg.data-ports-max: 1,152 x 10GbE, 288 x 40GbE or 240 x 100GbE (datasheet Table 1, with eight 30C cards)
svg.data-power-typical-scope: datasheet - base system, line cards not included; redundant system 1,765 W typical and 2,877 W reserved
svg.data-heat-dissipation: 48,156 BTU/hr (14,113 W) maximum thermal output, estimated and subject to change
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 C to 40 C (32 F to 104 F)
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing operating, 5 to 95 percent nonoperating
svg.data-storage: 50 GB onboard SSD, plus an optional SATA SSD of 50 GB or 100 GB in the RCB
svg.data-fabric: six switch interface boards, five required and the sixth for n+1; midplane-less
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45 (em0), 10/100/1000BASE-T, and MGMT SFP (em1), on each RCB
svg.data-usb: one USB 2.0 port on each RCB
svg.data-seismic: Designed to meet GR-63 Zone 4 earthquake requirements
